# DigBrushes

`world-system`

Which brush a dig makes: bare hands and each shovel or pick have a shape, a radius and the materials they cut; Mining skill grows the radius up to a cap; the rim is blended; yield is removed volume over a unit volume per material.

> A dig moves a shovelful, not a slab, and the tool decides what it can cut (Phase 300)

## Attributes

| Field | Type | Description |
| ----- | ---- | ----------- |
| radiusCap | decimal | Largest brush radius in metres, skill growth included |
| skillRadiusPerTier | decimal | Metres of brush radius added per Mining skill tier |
| blend | decimal | Default smooth-blend k in metres for the rim of a dig |
| minRadius | decimal | Under this radius a dig is the single slab (one tile) |
| brushes | json | { hands \| <tool item>: { shape: sphere\|cylinder\|box, radius, cuts: [material] } } |
| unitVolume | json | { default: m3 per yielded unit, overrides: { <material>: m3 } } |
